claim: If an Aurora DB cluster is associated with a backup plan in AWS Backup, that backup plan is used for point-in-time recovery.
question: Which backup plan is used for point-in-time recovery when an Aurora cluster is also in AWS Backup?

values.display: that backup plan is used for point-in-time recovery

qualifiers.condition: since September 2023 Aurora automated (continuous) backups can be managed in AWS Backup

evidence.quote: If your DB cluster is associated with a backup plan in AWS Backup, that backup plan is used for point-in-time recovery.
